name: UnoRouter
description: Router with 294 models behind one key, 159 of them marked free.
overview: UnoRouter fronts 294 models from 52+ upstreams through a single OpenAI-compatible key. Its own count marks 159 of them free — the `:free` suffix marks the route — including Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite, Gemma 4 12B, Codestral, Mistral Small, Cohere North Mini Code, Upstage Syn Pro and Nemotron 3 Nano Omni. It is aimed at coding agents and character-chat clients, with setup guides for Claude Code, Cline, Roo Code, SillyTavern and Open WebUI; paid routes share the same key.
free_access: One OpenAI-compatible key for every route
Setup guides for coding agents and chat clients
notes: Free routes rotate with upstream capacity; check the model page's own limit before depending on one.
